text:
katie.peopleops: morning — quick onboarding question. Contractor starts today and needs a company iPad for user-testing. MDM enrollment keeps failing with 'certificate_untrusted' when they're on guest wifi. Also: are contractors automatically excluded from phishing sims until their contract is fully signed/ID'd? who should I loop in? :wave:

alex.it: hey! guest networks often block our internal CA chain. Ask them to plug into corp wired or join corp-guest-vpn during enrollment. If they can't, we can try installing the profile via Safari. Can you paste the exact error?

katie.peopleops: here's the message they sent: `MDM enrollment failed: certificate_untrusted (com.redwood.mdm 0x103)`. Screenshot uploaded to the ticket: https://redwood.tickets/C-5421/screenshot.png

jin.security: contractors are NOT auto-exempt from phish sims by default. We can grant a short grace period while access is being provisioned, but formal exemptions require security approval and a ticket with contract ID. tagging @maya.security to assist. :lock:

maya.security: noted. we can do a 48h temporary exemption for phish sims while onboarding completes. please add contractor to the contractor_onboard Okta group and include contract ID in the ticket. contractors must still complete the security training within 7 days — we'll schedule reminders.

alex.it: workaround that often works on iPad: Settings -> General -> Profiles -> tap the provisioning profile CA -> Trust -> then re-run enrollment. If that doesn't work, install the profile through Safari using our on-board endpoint. Example we use internally: `curl -k https://mdm.redwood.internal/provision/profile.mobileconfig -o profile.mobileconfig` and then open the file on the iPad. (note: -k used only on internal network for self-signed chain; don't use publicly).

tyler.contractor: fwiw I'm on an Airalo eSIM and the VPN won't come up — trying the Safari profile install now. will update.

jin.security: quick policy note — we only issue longer phishsim exemptions after badge + identity verification. temporary tag okay for immediate blocking issues, but keep it minimal. please include justification in the ticket.

katie.peopleops: creating ticket now with contractor id C-5421, attaching screenshot and contract copy, requesting 48h phishsim grace and 7d training reminder. thanks for the quick help :thumbsup:

tyler.contractor: confirmed — installed via Safari and re-ran enroll. MDM shows status: "Compliant" in the app and I can see corporate apps being pushed. thanks!

alex.it: saw device come through JAMF: serial XXXXXXXXX — policies applied, VPN profile pushed.

onboarding-bot: reminder scheduled: security-training (ID: C-5421) due in 7 days; phishsim exemption tag applied until 2026-03-30.

maya.security: closing loop — exemption set until 2026-03-30, training reminder queued. marking this resolved on our side. :white_check_mark:
